panels.title: Control-plane CPU
panels.description: CPU used now by the whole node, pods and system, as in Node Allocation, and requested and limited by running and pending pods, as a share of the Ready control-plane nodes' allocatable, whatever the namespace filter. A node that isn't Ready, and its pods, are left out: its capacity can't take pods. Limits may pass 100%: they're overcommitted. A pod without a limit adds nothing to it.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m])) * on (node) group_left () (max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) and on (node) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"} * on (node) group_left () (max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) and on (node) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1))

sum(max by (namespace, pod, node) (label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}), "part", "containers", "", "") or label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}), "part", "init", "", "")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1) * on (node) group_left () (max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) and on (node) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"} * on (node) group_left () (max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) and on (node) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1))

sum(max by (namespace, pod, node) (label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"}), "part", "containers", "", "") or label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"}), "part", "init", "", "")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1) * on (node) group_left () (max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) and on (node) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"} * on (node) group_left () (max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) and on (node) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1))

panels.title: Requests against use, per workload
panels.description: What each workload in the selected namespaces used over the time range, at one-minute steps, against what it reserves. CPU is its 90th percentile, so a one-off spike such as a restart doesn't count; memory is its peak, since one peak above the request is enough to be evicted. The ratio is blue below 25%: it reserves far more than it uses. Above 100%, CPU is orange: it runs on spare CPU and slows when the node is busy. Memory is red: when the node runs short, its pods are evicted first. Requests and limits are the last a workload had in the time range, so a replaced ReplicaSet keeps its own; Pods is how many run at the range's end, 0 once it's gone. A workload without a request shows none: the scheduler counts it as zero. A request or limit counts its larger part, the containers or an init container, as the scheduler does.

targets.expr: count by (namespace, owner_name) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))) or 0 * last_over_time((count by (namespace, owner_name) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))))[$__range:1m])
